title: Agent Aech Session Spend Anomaly
instructions: Create an executive operations visual that explains the spend spike and shows what changed.

analysis.headline: Wednesday spend spiked 2.9x without a matching session-volume increase
analysis.narrative: Session count stayed within the normal weekly band, but tokens per session and tool retries surged on 2026-04-22, pointing to inefficient agent loops rather than demand growth.

insights.label: Demand was not the cause
insights.explanation: Session count moved from 79 to 84, but spend jumped from $438 to $1,240.

insights.label: Retry loops likely drove cost
insights.explanation: Tool retries rose to 63 while average tokens per session reached 56.7k.
